question: Saga Dawa festival is celebrated in which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Saga Dawa festival** is celebrated in the state of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• This festival is one of the most significant events for the **Buddhist community** in the state.
